scope: Complete view-component metadata discovery, not request processing or full application startup.

requirement_coverage.requirement: Same ordered list, retained existing duplicates, first-new order, actual repeated runtime AssemblyPart producer, null/non-type parts and threshold boundaries
Actual custom type enumeration preserves live add/remove/replace membership with 300 preexisting entries
Derived AssemblyPart interface reimplementation preserves producer mutation at 256 preexisting entries
Custom Assembly.DefinedTypes mutation preserves live membership and single enumeration at 256 entries
Arbitrary parts producer remains single-pass and its list mutation is observed
Null parts/feature errors retain exception type and parameter identity

producer_validation.reachability_boundary: Derived from exact final source, actual producer receipts and unchanged scenario part counts; not direct private index-creation instrumentation. The unchanged harness diagnostic describes the initial 32-entry prototype.

measurement_verdict.variance_cause: Unverified; no harmless-noise or index-cost attribution for non-index paths.

excluded_or_unverified: Full application startup or hosted HTTP/request throughput
Cold runtime, first-use metadata and assembly-loading cost
Concurrent discovery, concurrent metadata updates or pressure
Other runtimes, architectures and composition with other optimization branches
Production workload distribution and cause of control variance
